subject: Inspector access & DPIA evidence binder — Medicorps onboarding
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@medicorps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Inspector access & DPIA evidence binder — Medicorps onboarding

Samantha —

Thanks again for the onboarding call this morning. As discussed, we need to provide Medicorps' Privacy/Legal teams with a compact evidence "binder" and a short right-of-inspection plan so your auditors can complete the DPIA and Art. 28/30 review next week. To keep this scoped and timeboxed, I'm proposing the following minimal deliverables: 

1) Art. 30 processing ledger excerpt (examples of processing activities, data flows, subprocessors) — 2-week rolling snapshot.
2) Subprocessor access log sample (last 30 days) and the on-demand playback instructions for reproducing access traces.
3) KMS wrap/unwrap proof (key IDs and signing attestations) for sampled transactions.
4) DPIA evidence binder (pdf) that includes the DPIA summary, Annex A controls map, and our standard SOC2 control crosswalk.
5) A remote inspector access guide (VPN + jumpbox instructions) and timeboxed access window we can both agree on.

I've attached an evidence_request_template_v2.xlsx to capture the exact fields Medicorps wants. Please confirm: (a) which of the internal teams will inspect (names/emails); (b) whether Medicorps requires an onsite reviewer vs remote only; and (c) target date for completion.

Win conditions for us are a single 2-hour remote inspection slot (recorded) and a short follow-up Q&A. If Medicorps requires additional artifacts we'll scope that after initial review.

Availability: Wed 20 Jan 10:00–13:00 PT or Thu 21 Jan 08:00–11:00 PT.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Principal, Privacy & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_request_template_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 42 KB), DPIA_scope_summary.pdf (pdf, 180 KB)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@medicorps.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legalops@medicorps.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 11:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Inspector access & DPIA evidence binder — Medicorps onboarding

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear list. A couple quick points from our side: 

• Medicorps will do a remote inspection initially; we may request a single onsite spot-check later if anything requires deeper artifact access.
• Our privacy reviewer will be Samantha Lee (me) and I will loop in Legal Ops <legalops@medicorps.com> for the NDA / access approvals.
• For the KMS proofs: we need a sampling plan (how you pick transactions) and a brief description of how the wraps are audited (HSM vendor, key rotation cadence).

We can take Wed 20 Jan 10:30–12:30 PT for the remote inspection if you can guarantee the ledger excerpt and subprocessor access sample are ready 24 hours in advance.

Two asks for you now: 1) confirm the sampling criteria for KMS wrap artifacts; 2) send the DocuSign link or NDA template so Legal Ops can sign off.

— Sam
Samantha Lee
Privacy Counsel, Medicorps
Samantha.lee@medicorps.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Legal Ops <legalops@medicorps.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Inspector access & DPIA evidence binder — Medicorps onboarding

Sam — thanks, noted. Quick answers below and a couple of clarifications: 

KMS sampling criteria (summary):
- We'll pick a stratified sample across three buckets: (a) key IDs used in production event-signing in the last 30 days; (b) keys used for customer data-at-rest encryption in the last 90 days; (c) keys used for archival operations. Total sample = 8 transactions (randomized within buckets).
- For each sampled transaction we will provide the associated audit record (timestamped wrap/unwrap events) and the key metadata (key ID, HSM vendor, rotation timestamp).

Evidence delivery timeline:
- Ledger excerpt + subprocessor access sample: delivered Tue 19 Jan by 18:00 PT.
- KMS sampling pack: delivered Wed 20 Jan by 08:00 PT (so Medicorps can review before the 10:30 PT inspection).
- DPIA binder (PDF, signed cover): delivered Wed 20 Jan by 09:00 PT.

Access: we will provide a remote inspector role with read-only playback and session recording; access will be timeboxed to the 10:30–12:30 PT window. The access guide will be posted to the Drive folder (link below) and Legal Ops can approve via DocuSign.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/remote-sign/EXAMPLE-12345
Drive folder (evidence workspace): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cD-medicorps-onboarding-evidence

If Legal Ops needs any additional contractual language for the right-of-inspection beyond the DPA (e.g., data minimization during inspection), please flag now — we can standby to redline.

Jordan

Attachments: DPIA_scope_summary.pdf (pdf, 180 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 07:52:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Inspector access — prep notes

Jordan / team —

Forwarding quick prep notes for the inspection. We'll assemble the ledger excerpt and subprocessor access sample overnight. Two operational notes: 

1) Subprocessor access logs: we will provide an anonymized sample (redacted PII) and a mapping file that ties pseudonymous IDs to subprocessor role descriptions. If Medicorps requires full user IDs we will need a signed DPA addendum (legal has been notified).
2) KMS proofs: HSM vendor is SafeHaven HSM; rotation cadence is quarterly. Generating the signed wrap/unwrap audit requires a 48-hour runbook to export and verify signatures for the sample set.

We'll push the ledger excerpt to the Drive folder by 18:00 PT and the KMS pack by 08:00 PT. Jordan — happy to run through a dry-run at 09:15 PT on Wed.

— Ben Carter
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Jordan / Ben / team —

Thank you, that plan works for Medicorps. A few final confirmations before the 10:30 PT session: 

• Legal Ops has signed the access NDA (DocuSign completed).
• We received the ledger excerpt and subprocessor sample in Drive and the format is acceptable.
• KMS sampling pack looks good; we'll spot-check two wrap events in-session and may follow up with a short request after the recording.

Please share the meeting join link and the remote inspector credentials 15 minutes before the start time. We'll look to complete the DPIA checklist on the call and provide a short written report within 48 hours after the session.

— Sam
